reasons.reason: Adhesion proteins that the immune system flags as foreign become targets for antibodies and immune cells, so the colonizing strain would be recognized and cleared quickly, and the therapy would lose its effect before it could establish.

Once the immune system treats proteins on the probiotic as foreign antigens, the response can spread beyond the gut and begin attacking the body's own tissues that share similar structures, which would be the lasting consequence here.
Wave speed on a string is the square root of tension divided by linear density. With density fixed, four times the tension gives a square root of four, which is a factor of two.
The speed of a wave is set by the medium, and the string itself has not changed. Pulling it tighter only adjusts how hard you drive it, so the wave keeps traveling at the same speed.
Potential on a sphere is kQ/R, so with the charge held fixed the potential falls as the radius grows. Doubling the radius puts R in the denominator twice as large and halves the potential.

A bigger sphere has more surface for the charge to occupy, and the potential relates to how much work it takes to bring charge in. With the radius doubled and the charge unchanged, the potential should double too.

Plant proteins gain a meat-like texture when the matrix is frozen fast, because the ice crystals that form push the protein into strands and leave a porous, layered structure behind once everything thaws out.

Extruders push the protein mixture through a heated barrel under high shear. That denatures the chains and lines them up in one direction, producing the layered, anisotropic structure that resembles the fibers in muscle.

Position and momentum uncertainties trade off against each other, with their product bounded below by a constant. Pinning the electron's position down to a very small range forces the momentum spread to be very large.
A precise position measurement fixes the electron's state at that moment, and a definite state means its momentum is determined as well. So the uncertainty in momentum drops all the way to zero.
